scientific_role: Graph-prediction seed revision made after the V3b Top14 pre-execution mass audit and before any scientific V3b graph simulation. Provider-reconstruction and final-WB seed banks are unchanged.

provenance.reason_for_revision: Top14 retained mass was 0.551984 for P1, 0.961909 for P3, and 0.866545 for P4, so Top14 was not a uniformly adequate approximation to the full frozen 343-member M3 distribution.

M1_M2_common_bank.rule: reuse across M1 and all 27 M2 joint variants and across eligible physical cells as CRN

M3.rule: rank r uses seed_base+(r-1)*stride+k for k=0..N_r-1; rank streams are disjoint; same rank stream is reused across eligible physical cells as CRN, with provider-world-specific prefix length N_r

final_whitebox.note: Still unread and embargoed. This revision does not alter the final-WB bank.

engineering_smoke.rule: throwaway engineering-only evidence; never read by scientific stages
